chapters.title: Index map and a moving preorder pointer
chapters.code:
def build_tree(preorder, inorder):
    where = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(inorder)}
    nxt = 0

    def make(lo, hi):                       # inorder[lo..hi]
        nonlocal nxt
        if lo > hi:
            return None
        val = preorder[nxt]; nxt += 1
        mid = where[val]
        node = TreeNode(val)
        node.left = make(lo, mid - 1)       # left must be built first
        node.right = make(mid + 1, hi)
        return node

    return make(0, len(inorder) - 1)

chapters.title: Slice and search
chapters.code:
def build_tree(preorder, inorder):
    if not preorder:
        return None
    root = TreeNode(preorder[0])
    mid = inorder.index(preorder[0])
    root.left = build_tree(preorder[1:mid + 1], inorder[:mid])
    root.right = build_tree(preorder[mid + 1:], inorder[mid + 1:])
    return root
